> 第22章 火龙冲天（第1页）
一双眼睛睁开，目光如电，死死盯在天赋石上。
片刻，??一道欣喜的声音轻轻响起：“无星无天赋，果然是废物！”
高空之下，却是万众齐发的哄笑声，响彻全城。
陆家的长老们，个个面色如土，十分尴尬。
主考官见陆沉的手仍然按在天赋石上，不由恼怒的呵斥。
“你是傻了吧？没有天赋就是没有天赋，你再按多久，星也不会亮起来。”
下一刻，周若雪整个人征住了，周鹤也笑容凝固了，所有人都笑不出来了。
因为，天赋石闪过一道红芒，染红半边天！
别人武脉出现的前兆，光芒仅是一闪而逝。
可陆沉这个前兆，直接把天边染红，太夸张了！
现场寂静无声，所有人的目光汇聚在天赋石上，期待武脉出现。
奇怪的是，天赋石上没有出现武脉，而是红芒越来越盛，变成一块红得犹如火焰的石碑。
所有人都不禁紧张起来，不知接下来会发生什么？
即使是见多识广的三大长老，也是脸色徒变，神色凝重！
高空之上，那双眼睛熠熠生辉，闪烁诧异之色。
突兀间，火焰般的石碑化成一条火龙，直冲天际！
人们惊诧的看着火龙冲天，震憾得无以伦比，几乎全体石化！
主考官嘴巴张口，已经表达不出任何意思了。

周若雪直接僵化在那里，笑容早不见了，只有无尽惊慌！
火龙冲上云层，轰的一声，仿佛撞到了什么，再折回来，俯冲而下。
火光四射，火龙化作无数光芒，照亮全城。
火龙消失，天赋石恢复原状，静静的直立原地。
整个广场，数万武者，无人作声，一片寂静。
看台上，三位长老从震憾中清醒过来，你看看我，我看看你，均看到对方眼中的震惊之色！
碎沙门沙长老眼神迷惘，一头雾水，“从没听说过，有谁觉醒了龙形武脉，在四阶的武脉榜上，也没有龙系武脉的存在啊。”
天赋石测到武脉，会提前闪过一道光芒。
闪过黄光，那么测到的就是黄阶武脉。
武道世界，只有天、地、玄、黄四阶武脉！
然而，天赋石竟然闪出红光，这就没人知道是什么阶了。
飞霞门长老，正是那位老妪，她也是经过思考，才这般说道。“但是，武脉很强。”
“光有武脉无天赋，也是十分棘手啊。”
沙长老眉头皱起，口中叹道，“哪怕他有一星天赋，我也能将他培养成材。”
“的确棘手，但炎龙武脉太罕见，我紫云门……可从未有收过龙系武脉的弟子。”
一旁，江耀正从震憾中回过神来，听到自家长老有意收陆沉，心下大急。
紫云门只给双木城一个录取名额，若收了陆沉，周若雪怎么办？

> Chapter 22 The Fire Dragon Soars to the Sky (Page 1)
A pair of eyes opened, their gazes were like lightning, staring at the talent stone.
After a moment, a joyful voice sounded softly: "Without stars and talent, he is indeed a waste!"
High in the sky, the roar of laughter resounded throughout the city.
The elders of the Lu family all had pale faces and were very embarrassed.
Seeing that Lu Chen's hand was still pressed on the talent stone, the examiner couldn't help but scolded him angrily.
"Are you stupid? If you don't have talent, you don't have talent. No matter how long you press it, the star won't light up."
The next moment, Zhou Ruoxue was stunned, Zhou He's smile froze, and no one could laugh anymore.
Because, the talent stone flashed a red light, dyeing half the sky red!
The precursor to the emergence of someone else's martial veins only flashed away.
But Lu Chen's omen directly turned the sky red. It was too exaggerated!
The scene was silent, and everyone's eyes were focused on the talent stone, expecting the martial veins to appear.
The strange thing is that no martial veins appeared on the talent stone, but the red light became more and more intense, turning into a stone tablet as red as a flame.
Everyone can't help but become nervous, wondering what will happen next?
Even the three elders, who are well-informed, have pale faces and solemn expressions!
High in the sky, those eyes were shining with surprise.
Suddenly, the flaming stone tablet turned into a fire dragon and shot straight into the sky!
People watched in amazement as the fire dragon soared into the sky. They were so shocked that almost all of them were petrified!
The examiner opened his mouth, unable to express anything.
Zhou Ruoxue froze there, her smile long gone, only endless panic!
The fire dragon rushed up to the clouds with a bang, as if it hit something, then turned back and swooped down.
The fire was radiating, and the fire dragon turned into countless rays of light, illuminating the whole city.
The fire dragon disappeared, and the talent stone returned to its original shape, standing quietly in its place.
The entire square, filled with tens of thousands of warriors, was silent and silent.
In the stands, the three elders woke up from the shock. You looked at me, I looked at you, and they all saw the shock in each other's eyes!
Elder Broken Shamensha's eyes were confused and confused, "I have never heard of anyone awakening the dragon-shaped martial arts. There is no dragon-type martial arts on the fourth-level martial arts list."
When the talent stone detects the martial pulse, it will flash a light in advance.
If there is a flash of yellow light, then what is detected is the Huang-level martial pulse.
In the world of martial arts, there are only four levels of martial arts: heaven, earth, Xuan and Huang!
However, the talent stone actually flashed red, and no one knew what level it was.
The elder of Feixia Clan was the old woman. She said this after thinking about it. "But the martial arts are very strong."
"It's very difficult to have martial arts but no talent."
Elder Sha frowned and sighed, "Even if he has one star talent, I can train him to become a talented person."
"It is indeed difficult, but the Yanlong martial arts vein is too rare. Our Ziyun Sect... has never accepted a disciple with the dragon martial arts vein."
On the side, Jiang Yao was recovering from the shock. He was very worried when he heard that his elders wanted to take Lu Chen back.
Ziyunmen only gives one admission quota to Shuangmu City. If Lu Chen is accepted, what will Zhou Ruoxue do?
